`actual-deck.deckcraft` is a contributor-original native file created in the
isolated F6 SVG linked-update UI test. Shape 260 is a solid `#233456` slide
background. SHA-256:
`4f0c4ba5da138cf7883039e0ebb6f688680a4920452b3954e3308ad6f83e740f`.
It contains no user artwork. The companion Vector source is the existing
contributor-original `../svg-material/source.vectorcraft` fixture.

`brand-vector-before.vectorcraft`, `brand-vector-after.vectorcraft`,
`brand-deck-before.deckcraft`, and `brand-deck-after.deckcraft` are real
before/after saves captured by `capture_brand_fill.py` from contributor-original
designs. Native Vector object 2 and Deck object 260 change only from `#287D6C`
to `#C03020`; no user artwork or model-generated content is present.

`brand-deck-marker-before.deckcraft`, `brand-deck-marker-after.deckcraft`, and
`brand-deck-marker.json` were captured by the actual uninstalled Deck engine
test with `shape.assignBrandOrigins`; the added token is random, test-only data.
`brand-vector-marker-before.vectorcraft`, `brand-vector-marker-after.vectorcraft`,
and `brand-vector-marker.json` were saved by the actual uninstalled Vector
engine test after its real `object.setProps` marker assignment; the token is random.
